segments.name: Optum Health
segments.description: Delivers comprehensive, patient-centered care and health financial services to consumers, employers, payers and public entities.
segments.evidence: Optum Health delivers patient-centered care, care management, wellness and consumer engagement, and health financial services;

segments.name: Optum Insight
segments.description: Provides data, analytics, technology and managed services to health systems, health plans, governments and life sciences companies.
segments.evidence: Optum Insight offers data, analytics, research, consulting, technology and managed services solutions;

segments.name: UnitedHealthcare
segments.description: Offers a full range of health benefits to consumers, employers, seniors and economically disadvantaged populations.
segments.evidence: UnitedHealthcare, which includes UnitedHealthcare Employer & Individual, UnitedHealthcare Medicare & Retirement and UnitedHealthcare Community & State.

revenueModel.text: The company earns premiums and fees from health benefit plans, monthly premiums and fees under value-based and administrative arrangements, contracted fees for services, and fees plus investment and interest income from financial services.
revenueModel.evidence: Optum Health offerings include fully accountable value-based arrangements, where Optum Health assumes responsibility for health care costs in exchange for a monthly premium.
